scope: All 26 hardship, utility, telecom, banking and related income-loss entries selected from the immutable restricted/network-error baseline after the critical, health-safety and tenancy reviews. Historical references retained; destination and noted content only, not exhaustive financial/legal review.

reviews.title: Ombudsman NT complaints
reviews.note: Official complaint process reviewed: agency first, records and requested outcome; normally matters learned of within twelve months, with exceptions. Added scope check naming Power and Water/Jacana from separate jurisdiction page.

reviews.title: Choose your mobile service carefully
reviews.note: CIS, three network operators, device and Triple Zero compatibility checked. Existing SIM guide already distinguishes coverage estimates from actual service and keeps unsupported emergency-capable devices out.

reviews.title: Choosing an NBN plan
reviews.note: Key Facts Sheet, busy-period expectations, factors reducing speed, equipment and power-failure/medical-alarm limitations confirmed. Existing connection and comparison guidance retained.

reviews.title: Choosing the right product or plan
reviews.note: CIS inclusion/exclusion, price, minimum term and complaints information confirmed. Telephone-sales delivery rules differ; no universal instantaneous CIS promise added.

reviews.title: How to complain to your telco
reviews.note: Provider first; urgent complaints generally resolved within two business days and non-urgent proposed resolution up to ten working days. Page mixes five and ten working days for agreed implementation; no universal agreed-completion deadline asserted.

reviews.title: ID checks for prepaid mobiles
reviews.note: Activation needs identity checks and name/date of birth/address; permitted verification methods vary. Existing official-channel handling and no sensitive ID in shared checklists retained.

reviews.title: Keep or port your phone number
reviews.note: Only active numbers port, new provider arranges process and previous debt/handset obligations remain. Usual three-hour mobile period is not a guaranteed deadline.

reviews.title: Managing your phone bill
reviews.note: Contract/CIS rate checks, unfamiliar charges, earlier bills and direct-debit information verified. Existing itemised first-bill comparison and separate contract/payment cancellation retained.

reviews.title: Telecommunications Financial Hardship Industry Standard
reviews.note: Current industry guide describes realistic assistance, six minimum options, preserving connection and collection safeguards. Added consumer-facing companion rather than treating industry rules as an application form.

reviews.title: Understanding your energy bill
reviews.note: Account, billing period, meter readings, fixed supply and usage charges verified. Retail customer scope ACT/NSW/QLD/SA/TAS explicitly distinguished from VIC/WA/NT.

reviews.title: Customer hardship policies
reviews.note: AER approved retailer policies apply under National Energy Retail Law in ACT/NSW/QLD/SA/TAS. Retained policy lookup, realistic payments and concessions; not a national application portal.

reviews.title: Receiving banks and unauthorised opening of accounts
reviews.note: Browser verified expanded jurisdiction from 12 March 2026 including certain receiving-bank/non-customer scam cases. Older incident dates may qualify; standard time limits and prior complaints matter. Not automatic compensation or the start of the separate Scams Prevention Framework.

reviews.title: Banking deposits and payments complaints
reviews.note: Browser verified deposits, transfers, direct debits, mistaken/unauthorised transactions and limits on fee-only disputes. Membership and issue eligibility remain required; free AFCA is not a guaranteed recovery service.

reviews.title: Financial hardship complaints
reviews.note: Browser verified that a request need not use a formal process; no reply or dissatisfaction after approaching firm can be raised with AFCA. Removed implication that a written refusal must arrive first.

reviews.title: Why you might be asked for ID
reviews.note: AUSTRAC explains institution/transaction-dependent ID and ongoing due diligence, including existing customers and source-of-funds information. Added verify-through-official-bank-channel safeguard; no universal 100-point rule.

reviews.title: Fair Entitlements Guarantee
reviews.note: Official overview and detailed claim guide verified: last resort following liquidation/bankruptcy; citizenship/visa, timing and effective claim requirements; unpaid super excluded. Added direct claim-eligibility source.

reviews.title: Emergency relief
reviews.note: DSS describes provider-dependent food, transport/chemist vouchers, partial utility help and referrals. No automatic cash or availability guarantee; community relief distinguished from Centrelink Crisis Payment.

reviews.title: Supporting people in financial crises
reviews.note: DSS explicitly describes free Emergency Relief without citizenship or residency requirements. Community support and National Debt Helpline referral confirmed. Linked grants-directory query returned no results; not represented as a verified local match.

reviews.title: Switch to save
reviews.note: Government state-specific comparison routes and supply/usage charges confirmed. WA/NT/VIC differences retained; no automatic whole-market lowest-price or savings promise added.

reviews.title: Your rights as an energy customer
reviews.note: National Energy Customer Framework jurisdiction, bill review, support and provider-first complaint routes verified. Added named state coverage; disconnection/embedded-network eligibility still needs local assessment.

reviews.title: How to read your energy bill
reviews.note: VIC official page confirms Best Offer is retailer-specific, Payment Difficulty Framework support and EWOV. Future October 2026 disconnection threshold mentioned by source is not presented as already operative.

reviews.title: Power, electricity and gas
reviews.note: TAS official referral page confirms independent energy complaints after provider contact and two years from awareness. Original percent-encoded comma URL remains usable; decoding is not treated as a broken-link replacement.

reviews.title: Electricity retailers
reviews.note: Power and Water lists regional retailers and remote-area exceptions. Clarified network operator versus bill issuer; not all NT residents buy electricity from Power and Water.

reviews.title: Pricing and tariffs
reviews.note: Power and Water pricing page lists tariffs effective 1 July 2026 and retailer/remote exceptions. Relabelled as tariff reference, not a hardship application. No exact prices copied because applicability varies.

reviews.title: Crisis Payment
reviews.note: Services Australia identifies separate extreme-circumstance payment types and severe-hardship conditions. Added companion for Other Extreme Circumstances only; seven-day contact trigger and fourteen-day claim period not generalized to every payment type.

reviews.title: When you need an Employment Separation Certificate
reviews.note: Services Australia says certificate may be required when person/partner stops work or changes full-time to casual, depending on payment and circumstances. Clarified conditional need rather than every departure.

supportingSources.note: Consumer guide reviewed: five-business-day assessment and two-business-day outcome notification, realistic assistance and essential connection; not a waiver guarantee.
Other Extreme Circumstances only: all eligibility requirements, exclusions, seven-day contact trigger and fourteen-day claim period after contacting Services Australia.
Effective FEG claim within twelve months of later employment end or insolvency date; citizenship/visa status at employment end and unpaid super exclusion.
Public browser jurisdiction list names Power Water / Jacana Energy. Automated detail-page retries timed out; no claim that every private retailer is covered.
Navigation to the detailed claim eligibility guide; no submission.
Public overview used to reach detailed conditions and claim methods; no account access.
Public instructions confirm phone/service-centre alternative if online claim unavailable. No form or login opened.
DSS-linked directory loaded filters but no results. Not used as a verified service listing; main Emergency Relief guidance retained.
